atoms.text: An accident or allergic reaction could cause a person to fall unconscious. In this situation, the person needs urgent help, and you must call 999. While you wait for help to arrive, you can follow these steps to help the unconscious person:
First, check whether the person is breathing or not. You can do this by checking if the person’s chest is still rising and falling.
You can also check for breathing by putting your ear above the person’s mouth and nose. You should be able to hear and feel their breath.

atoms.a: How can you tell if an unconscious person is still breathing? Choose the three correct answers.
b: ++Their chest is still rising and falling.
++You can hear the sounds of breathing coming from their nose or mouth.
++You can feel their breathing from their nose or mouth.

instruction.text: If the unconscious person is still breathing, you can put them in the recovery position. Fill in the gaps to learn more.

atoms.b: Firstly, take the closest arm of the unconscious person and lay it out, ((++bent_at_a_right_angle straight_from_the_shoulder)), beside their head.
Then, lay their other arm across their chest, so that the back of their hand is touching their ((++cheek hip)).
Holding everything in place, roll them ((++towards_you away_from_you)) onto their side.
Finally, gently pull the person’s head backwards and open their ((eyes ++mouth)).
